site: MeowDB (NiaMeowDB), a community database. Rebranding to NiaDB announced for late Oct / early Nov 2026; old links said to keep working.
game_version_seen: Pages cite Capybara Go v1.8.x (v1.8.4 through v1.8.12 seen).

core_loop.statement: No single core-loop statement on the source pages. Index sections name the systems: Story and Hard Mode stages; Gulu Mine (unlocks after Story chapter 31); PvP and cross-server (Alien Minefield, Guild Hegemony); Events and Homestead; spending and packs; progression (pets, collectibles, relics, polarization); mechanics (crowd control, DoT, damage caps, tenacity).

daily_systems.name: Stamina regeneration
daily_systems.numbers: Base 60 stamina per 24 h (1 per 24:00). Perky pet talent track reaches +30% at max (78 per 24 h, 18:27 each). Royal Roses awakening track: 90 per 24 h at 5-star; 108 per 24 h (13:20 each) at 5-star awakened max. Page says the table assumes Perky is already applied.
daily_systems.type: data table (credit: gnocchi, Capy Data Squad)

daily_systems.name: Dungeon Dive challenge vouchers
daily_systems.numbers: 2 Challenge Vouchers per day (guide says buy 2 daily). Described as best gem-to-reward ratio in the game.

daily_systems.name: Free-to-play gem income
daily_systems.numbers: About 4,000 gems per day, about 27,000 per week.

daily_systems.name: Monthly + Lifetime Pass gem income
daily_systems.numbers: About 5,000 gems per day, about 35,000 per week.

daily_systems.name: Guru Fund
daily_systems.numbers: 11 brackets of 14 score points. Each bracket costs 2,000 gems and pays 1,400 gold + 150 keys. Full run: 22,000 gems for 15,400 gold + 1,650 keys.

daily_systems.name: Growth Events
daily_systems.numbers: 1,000 gems per round x 4 rounds = 4,000 gems per fully cleared Growth Event.

daily_systems.name: Gulu Mine
daily_systems.numbers: Unlocks after Story chapter 31; +1 floor per 10 more Story chapters; max 30 floors. Floors 1-7 drop Normal, Fine and Rare gems; floor 8+ adds Mythic chances; floor 11+ adds Immortal chances.

daily_systems.name: Alien Minefield (PvP window)
daily_systems.numbers: 5-day PvP / cross-server window. Stone points: Quartzite 1, Kyanite 10, Spodumene 200 (1 Spodumene = 200 Quartzites or 20 Kyanites).

daily_systems.name: Fisherman's Journey
daily_systems.numbers: 10-day Fishing Points battle pass. Free track about 1,200 gems + about 500 bait. Paid track adds about 1,000 gems and 3 UP Wish Letters.

daily_systems.name: Joint Archaeology (recurring 5-day carnival)
daily_systems.numbers: Refreshable daily packs. Daily Best Value $5.99 = 100 gems + 40 Mount Cores + 40 pickaxes + 40 Sunrise Chests.

daily_systems.name: Immortal Peach Garden (annual ~10-day event)
daily_systems.numbers: Growth timers: Longevity Peach 38 min, Treasure Fruit 4 h, Ginseng Fruit 8 h. Max yield ranges printed as 180-450 and 320-800.

daily_systems.name: Guild Hegemony dice
daily_systems.numbers: Guild Hegemony Dice x1,000 for 600 gems; limit 10 per event (v1.8.8 guide).

passive_skills.name: Spawn of Evil
passive_skills.effect: At under 50% HP for the first time: gain protection of Spawn of Evil until battle ends. 60% chance to poison on attack.

passive_skills.name: Angel Power
passive_skills.effect: Battle start: gain protection of Angel for 6 rounds. 60% chance on attack to recover 10% of max HP.
